kai: hi all, second day here. setting up on an M1 Air and debating: use the devcontainer or native asdf installs? i tried asdf python but hit `configure: error: cannot find OpenSSL` during build. any quick wins?

frank: welcome! quick win: install brew openssl and point flags before build. on mac (arm):

frank: ```bash
brew install openssl@1.1 readline xz
export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib/pkgconfig

asdf install python latest
```

frank: or use the devcontainer image if you want zero local deps: ghcr.io/redwood/dev/devcontainer:stable. it already has pinned openssl and go/rust toolchains.

kai: thanks — that env vars trick worked for python. two followups: (1) where to keep REDWOOD_API_KEY for local apps? (2) node & yarn recommendations?

olivia: put long-lived tokens in 1Password and use the CLI in your direnv. example `.envrc`: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY="$(op item get "redwood/dev-key" --fields label=token)"` then `direnv allow`. avoids accidental commits.

olivia: node: use `asdf plugin-add nodejs` and install LTS. remember to run `corepack enable` after installing node so yarn/pnpm work as expected. if you need native modules, ensure Python is first in PATH and Xcode CLT installed: `xcode-select --install`.

infra-bot: NOTE: register your SSH pubkey in the internal portal (Access -> SSH Keys) to get repo and bastion access. If you build against corporate certs, set `SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/redwood.pem`.

kai: great — i prefer local for now but will try devcontainer for debugging. last Q: any dotfiles template or required PATHs?

frank: fork `github.com/redwood/dotfiles-template`. ensure `~/.local/bin` and `~/.config/redwood` are in PATH. add `~/.config/redwood/.env` to gitignored files.

kai: perfect. i'll ping if i hit anything else. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
